{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Originator** – Who proposed the idea.
- **Date Proposed** – When the idea was submitted.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, Under Review, In Development, Completed, Archived).
- **Priority** – 1 (Low) to 5 (High).
- **Notes** – Additional comments, feedback, or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Scroll to the bottom.
3. Add a new entry following the structure above.
4. Save the document.

## Review Process
- **Weekly Review**: Team leads will review new ideas every Friday.
- **Decision Criteria**: Feasibility, impact, alignment with goals, and resource availability.
- **Action Items**: Assign owners and set deadlines.

---

## Current Ideas

| Idea ID | Title | Description | Originator | Date Proposed | Status | Priority | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|------------|---------------|--------|----------|-------|
| 001 | AI-Powered Chatbot | Develop a chatbot that uses GPT-4 to answer customer queries. | Alice | 2026-08-30 | New | 4 | Awaiting feasibility study |

Feel free to add more ideas below.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.md"}

{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Originator** – Who proposed the idea.
- **Date Proposed** – When the idea was submitted.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, Under Review, In Development, Completed, Archived).
- **Priority** – 1 (Low) to 5 (High).
- **Notes** – Additional comments, feedback, or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Scroll to the bottom.
3. Add a new entry following the structure above.
4. Save the document.

## Review Process
- **Weekly Review**: Team leads will review new ideas every Friday.
- **Decision Criteria**: Feasibility, impact, alignment with goals, and resource availability.
- **Action Items**: Assign owners and set deadlines.

---

## Current Ideas

| Idea ID | Title | Description | Originator | Date Proposed | Status | Priority | Notes |

| 001 | AI-Powered Chatbot | Develop a chatbot that uses GPT-4 to answer customer queries. | Alice | 2026-08-30 | New | 4 | Awaiting feasibility study |

Feel free to add more ideas below.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.md"}

{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Originator** – Who proposed the idea.
- **Date Proposed** – When the idea was submitted.
- **Status** – Current state (e.g., New, Under Review, In Development, Completed, Archived).
- **Priority** – 1 (Low) to 5 (High).
- **Notes** – Additional comments, feedback, or next steps.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this document.
2. Scroll to the bottom.
3. Add a new entry following the structure above.
4. Save the document.

## Review Process
- **Weekly Review**: Team leads will review new ideas every Friday.
- **Decision Criteria**: Feasibility, impact, alignment with goals, and resource availability.
- **Action Items**: Assign owners and set deadlines.

---

## Current Ideas

| Idea ID | Title | Description | Originator | Date Proposed | Status | Priority | Notes |
|---------|-------|-------------|------------|---------------|--------|----------|-------|
| 001 | AI-Powered Chatbot | Develop a chatbot that uses GPT-4 to answer customer queries. | Alice | 2026-08-30 | New | 4 | Awaiting feasibility study |

Feel free to add more ideas below.
", "file_name": "TeamNotes.txt"}
